summary.en-US: A mod to make Traumasoft mobile-friendly. Post-Traumatic puts the most-used options directly in the top bar and restructures the schedule, work order, checklist, and punch clock pages for dramatically increased usability.

description.en-US: A mod to make Traumasoft mobile-friendly. Works with Safari on iPhone or Firefox on Android. Post-Traumatic puts the most-used options directly in the top bar and restructures the schedule, work order, checklist, and punch clock pages for dramatically increased usability. It also lets the log-in page remember your username after the first time it's typed. The rest of the site is unchanged.

release_notes.en-US: Unit views: a Base dropdown beside the month picker shows one base's units; the year picker and the time-off colour key wait behind small links; the day strip is a week of chips edge to edge with no arrows; the All / Open only / Mine buttons are gone; the Calendar button appears once a name is typed and the status line only during a search; past days are no longer faded; during a search the chips show only that person's count; Management joins the common views. Shifts through midnight: a partner listed by the site under the next day is shown on the unit card and on your own shifts, with the hours alone marked.
